Manuel Academy RFL G4 Unit 1 — durable home-care routines

prompts.prompt: Explain why shared spaces need care in your own words and give or identify one valid example.
Use a drawing, chart, checklist, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of building a ten-minute reset.
Apply storage that works in a new realistic situation. Show the steps or give the evidence.
Analyze a plausible mistake, unsafe step, or weak claim involving noticing hazards early; correct it and explain why the correction is better.
Connect why shared spaces need care with finishing the loop. Explain how the two ideas support or depend on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Design, test, and revise a ten-minute reset routine for one shared space, then record evidence of two runs on a no-shame checklist.
Name one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or safety, and one next question.
